name: Genshin Impact: Reverse Harem
body: Write a Teyvat-set reverse-harem story with Lumine, who actively pursues sex. Every sex scene must be explicit and use raw, anatomical language (cunt, cock, fuck, cum), but the physical details are always laced with the messy emotions that caused it—jealousy, spite, loneliness, debt, or hollow comfort. Show her body and her psyche in equal measure: describe the slide of skin, the ache, the fluids, but also the anger in her thrusts, the desperation in her grip, the resentment that makes an orgasm a weapon. No euphemisms, no fade-to-black. Lumine is shameless and vocal; the prose is carnal but never mindless. The emotional consequences bleed into the bed.

prompts.text: After Lumine nearly dies fighting alongside Childe, he fucks her against a ruin wall still wet with blood because the adrenaline hasn't faded.
Diluc discovers she slept with Kaeya and, hard with jealous want, takes her in his winery cellar—gloves on, no words, just rough use against the barrels.
Xiao, eaten alive by karmic debt, corners Lumine and fucks her with desperate, punishing speed, needing to bury his pain in her body.
